connector.name: MCP by giftcardshop.org
connector.registryDescription: Browse the giftcardshop catalog and buy gift cards with Lightning over MCP. No account, no signup.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace org.giftcardshop. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GCS_INTERNAL_SECRET
env.description: 64-hex HMAC secret that enables create_order (Lightning checkout). Browsing tools work without it. Requested at https://giftcardshop.org/contact.

env.name: GCS_API_BASE
env.description: Override the public API base. Defaults to https://api.giftcardshop.org.
